blurb: Studio Seventeen Dance offers gentle, age-appropriate preschool dance classes designed specifically for children ages 2–5. The program focuses on building confidence, kindness, and connection, with short classes and playful structure. The studio emphasizes community and long-term growth for dancers from toddlers to adults.
